name: understudy-monorepo
description: The Playwright framework your AI agent already knows by heart.

scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run sync:check
scripts.generate: pnpm --filter @understudy/engine run build && pnpm --filter @understudy/eslint-plugin run generate && pnpm --filter @understudy/cli run generate && pnpm --filter @understudy/mcp run generate && pnpm run build && pnpm run docs:generate && pnpm run skills:generate
scripts.sync:check: pnpm --filter @understudy/eslint-plugin run generate:check && pnpm --filter @understudy/cli run generate:check && pnpm --filter @understudy/mcp run generate:check && pnpm run docs:check && pnpm run skills:check
scripts.release: pnpm run verify && pnpm run generate && pnpm -r publish
